provider_receipt.summary: Review does not approve the joined result. Defect 1: the supplied verification receipt substantiates only a clean tree for a stated “sole project leaf”; it provides no implementation, test, or artifact evidence that the full two-leaf joined objective was satisfied. Defect 2: the two dependency close receipts contain only generic closure summaries and use different project-contract digests, while the review capsule identifies only the first digest; the second leaf’s governed scope and result cannot be validated. Defect 3: the inspected implementation contradicts its ingestion contract: scan_vault serializes every Markdown note as semantic memory without classifying authority, privacy, status, review requirements, provenance, or conflicts, and MemoryStore::store discards the serialized record rather than persisting it (src/lib.rs:56-88,107-125; docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25,71-93,96-123,145-173). Defect 4: the durable evidence includes no behavioral check for these ingestion and persistence requirements; clean-tree evidence proves only absence of project changes, not objective correctness. No declared checks were rerun and no files were modified.
